name: LottieFiles MCP
description: The official LottieFiles MCP server. Search 100,000+ free Lottie animations, pull them into your projects, and organize your workspace from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Hosted by LottieFiles, authorized with OAuth, free on every plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LottieFiles MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LottieFiles MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lottiefiles.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LottieFiles MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LottieFiles MCP provides these MCP tools: graphql_execute, operations_list, schema_details, and schema_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LottieFiles MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LottieFiles MCP in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does LottieFiles MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: LottieFiles MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LottieFiles MCP is developed by LottieFiles. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
